ES01.en: SPY: Yes Butcher, we're here, but in a bit of a sticky situation.
ES01.zh: 间谍：是的，屠夫，我们到了，但处境有点棘手。

CO02.en: GREEN BERET: Yes, I heard, resistance intercepted a transmission from the train. Listen, I'm a few miles away from your position. It looks like the Nazis are looking to derail the train. Leave it to me lads, I'll make sure you can get through.
CO02.zh: 绿贝雷：是的，我听说了，抵抗组织截获了火车发出的电报。听着，我离你们的位置只有几英里。看来纳粹想炸毁铁轨让火车脱轨。交给我吧兄弟们，我会确保你们能通过。

ES02.en: SPY: Sounds good but the train will still be packed full of enemy soldiers.
ES02.zh: 间谍：听起来不错，但火车上仍会挤满敌军士兵。

CO03.en: GREEN BERET: OK, we can tackle that later. I have to make sure there's a train to get on to first.
CO03.zh: 绿贝雷：好，那事可以稍后再处理。我得先确保还有火车可上。

FLMA.en: YOU HAVE RUN OUT OF TIME

OR01.en: Eliminate the enemy and their vehicles. Move the truck off the tracks so that the train can pass.
OR01.zh: 消灭敌人及其车辆。把卡车移出铁轨，好让火车通过。

TIP1.en: Explosive Barrels: All of your men can utilise these barrels. Fire at an explosive barrel to blow it up. The Green Beret can carry a barrel and move it to a different position. He cannot run whilst carrying a barrel.
TIP1.zh: 爆炸桶：你的所有队员都能利用这些桶。向爆炸桶射击可将其引爆。绿贝雷能扛起一只桶并搬到别处，但扛桶时无法奔跑。
